# Notes-set guide template

Copy the Markdown below into a `README.md` beside your notes. Replace every bracketed prompt. Keep file links relative to that folder and make them point to actual uploads. Use **Not recorded** for unknown facts and **Not applicable** where appropriate.

```markdown
# [Course name: short name for this set]

**[Open the notes](./Course_Topic_Notes.pdf)**

**Teacher:** [Sir or Miss followed by the name; retain Dr where applicable, or use Not recorded].  
**Notes by:** [Preferred name, alias, or Shared without public author credit].  
**Course code:** [Code, or Not recorded].  
**Program, section, term/year:** [Known context; mark missing parts].  
**Programming language:** [C++, Java, Not applicable, or Not recorded].

**Coverage:** [Topics included. Say whether this is a complete course set or a partial set, and list missing topics/pages.]

## Files

- [Notes](./Course_Topic_Notes.pdf): [What this file contains.]
- [Practice](./Course_Topic_Practice.pdf): [Optional second file; remove if unused.]

## Source and sharing

[State who made the material, where it came from, and the permission or license that allows this repository to host and share it. Record the agreed public credit and reuse terms. Keep private evidence out of this page; say if a maintainer has verified it privately.]

[Teacher or resource group](../README.md) · [Course guide](../../README.md) · [All courses](../../../README.md) · [Contribute](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md)
```

Keep the direct PDF link at the top. Use the file list only when there are multiple files, and remove unused example links before submitting.
